note: Set A correctly extracts the Wiring Schedule items with accurate values, whereas Set B hallucinates non-existent schedule items (21, 22, 24) and provides incorrect wire sizes for existing items (e.g., claims Item 20 is 3#10 instead of 3#12, Item 50 is 3#8 instead of 3#6). Both sets suffer from OCR errors in quotes (reading '3#4/0' as '3440'), but Set A's extracted values are far more faithful to the document content.
